title: Scrollable help overlay
lead: *Proposed.* With help open, up/down (and j/k) scroll it a line and pgup/pgdown a page. Help lines wrap instead of being clipped or shortened, so every key and its full label can be read at 80x24.
findings_note: 2026-11-17 spec draft from S231 (S69 item 5) and S232 (S67 item 6), owner decision adj 439. The help body is windowed from the top with no way to move it: `m.showHelp` sends `helpLines` to the body (`internal/tui/view.go:79-80`), the window starts at 0 because no row is selected (`view.go:310-335`), and the row keys do nothing under help (`internal/tui/model.go:803-805`). At 80x24 the Roadmap help ends with `+8 more lines` (`testdata/golden/roadmap-help-80x24-mono.txt:21`), and help lines are clipped (`enter open run, question, item or decision; other rows se...`, same golden line 11) or shortened (`l launch`, `view.go:879-884`).

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
Owner decisions (2026-11-17): adj 439 (Q4), the help overlay becomes scrollable (up/down, pgup/pgdn), so the 80x24 help has no line that cannot be reached; labels stay full.

Re-checked at HEAD f48a6154:

- S231, S69 item 5, still present. At 80x24 the Roadmap help shortens `l launch a ready slice (Roadmap)` to `l launch` when `O slicer tui` joins the line (`internal/tui/view.go:879-884`; `testdata/golden/roadmap-help-80x24-mono.txt:15`). `docs/dashboard.md:2176-2178` documents the shortening.
- S232, S67 item 6, still present. The 80x24 Roadmap help ends `+8 more lines` (`roadmap-help-80x24-mono.txt:21`), and no key reaches those lines: `RowNext`/`RowPrev` return at once under help (`internal/tui/model.go:803-805`), and the window start is computed only from a selected row (`view.go:310-312`). `docs/dashboard.md:2181-2182` says the help body is clipped at 80x24.
- Help lines are clipped with `...` (`clip`, `internal/tui/overview.go:1470-1478`, used throughout `helpLines`, `view.go:759-900`).

Interpretation for the owner to confirm at the UI pass: the window keeps its dim `+N lines above` and `+N more lines` markers as scroll cues (`view.go:998-1012`); "no cut" means every line can be scrolled into view.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- `TestHelpScrollsByLineAndPage` (80x24, Roadmap, the `slicerTuiHarness` project): press `?`; the first body line is `Keys` and the body ends with a `+N more lines` marker. Press `down`: the first body line is a `+1 lines above` marker (the window moved one line). Press `pgdown` until the marker `more lines` is gone (at most 5 presses): the last help line (`enter (answer) submit free text` or whatever `helpLines(60, bodyH)` ends with) is on screen. Press `pgup` until `lines above` is gone: `Keys` is back. `j` and `k` act as `down` and `up`. Red first: the window does not move.
- `TestHelpReopensAtTheTop`: scroll down, press `?` twice: the first body line is `Keys`. Also after `esc` and `?`. Red first: the scroll keys do nothing, so this passes only once scroll exists; it pins the reset.
- `TestHelpLinesWrapInsteadOfClipping`: at 80x24 on the Roadmap, every line of `helpLines` is at most 60 columns, none ends in `...`, and the joined plain text contains `open run, question, item or decision; other rows select project` and `l launch a ready slice (Roadmap)`. Red first: the `enter` line is clipped and `l launch` is shortened.
- `TestHelpScrollDoesNotMoveTheRowCursor`: with help open, `down` three times, then `?`: `m.roadmapCursor` is unchanged. Passes on arrival; pins that the keys scroll help only.
- `TestHelpHintNamesTheScrollKeys`: with help open at 80x24 on the Roadmap, the hint line reads `up/down pgup/pgdown scroll; ? or esc close help; q quit`; at 200x60, where the help fits, it reads `? or esc close help; q quit` as today. Red first: no scroll keys on the hint.
- Goldens: the ten help goldens listed in Files change (wrapped lines; the 80x24 hint). Rewrite with `go test ./internal/tui -update` and review the diff.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. Write the failing tests above and see them red.
2. `model.go`: add a help scroll offset. With help open, `up`/`k` and `down`/`j` move it by one line, `pgup`/`pgdown` by the body height minus the marker lines; clamp it so the last page ends flush. Opening help sets it to 0. Do not change the row cursor.
3. `view.go`: when help is shown, the window starts at the help offset (clamped as `windowStart(len(body)-1, ...)` does). In `helpLines`, wrap each line at the body width with a two-space hang (as `wrapText` does) instead of `clip`; remove the `l launch ready slice` / `l launch` shortening (`view.go:879-884`).
4. `keys.go`: when help is open and its body does not fit, the hint offers the scroll keys first.
5. `go test ./internal/tui -update`; review every changed golden; run without `-update`.
6. Docs: `docs/dashboard.md`: help scrolls with up/down and pgup/pgdown, keeps full labels, and starts at the top each time it opens; replace the 80x24 clipping and shortening sentences (`:2176-2182`). CHANGELOG.md: one bullet at the end of `## Unreleased`.
7. UI slice: UI pass (r14).

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
Acceptance criteria:

- At 80x24, every line of the Roadmap help can be scrolled into view with down and pgdown, and back with up and pgup.
- No help line is clipped with `...`, and `l launch a ready slice (Roadmap)` is shown in full at 80x24.
- Help opens at its top each time.
- Scrolling help never moves the row cursor.
- The help hint names the scroll keys only when the help does not fit.

Commands:

- `go vet ./...` exits 0.
- `go test ./...` exits 0.
- `go test ./internal/tui -run 'Help' -v` lists the new tests as passing.
- `gofmt -l .` prints nothing.
- `slicer check --root /home/jon/code/squalor-xyz/ork` exits 0.
- `adj lint` exits 0.
- `rg -n 'l launch ready slice' internal/tui/view.go` prints nothing.
- `rg -n '\.\.\.' testdata/golden/roadmap-help-80x24-mono.txt` prints nothing.
- [HUMAN CHECK] In an 80x24 terminal, on the Roadmap press `?`, then `down` 3 times, `pgdown` until the end, `pgup` to the top, and `?` again: the text moves smoothly, the markers count right, nothing is cut mid-word, and the second `?` closes help. Repeat on the Overview and Waves views.
